mapper.sql: r.*, s.name AS store_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, dw.name AS defective_warehouse_name, (SELECT SUM(it.shipped_qty) FROM ecom_fba_removal_item it WHERE it.removal_id = r.id) AS shipped_qty, (SELECT SUM(it.disposed_qty) FROM ecom_fba_removal_item it WHERE it.removal_id = r.id) AS disposed_qty, (SELECT SUM(it.received_qty + it.defective_qty) FROM ecom_fba_removal_item it WHERE it.removal_id = r.id) AS received_qty
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ecom_fba_removal r LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = r.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = r.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse dw ON dw.id = r.defective_warehouse_id
r.store_id = #{storeId} AND r.removal_type = #{removalType} AND r.status = #{status}
AND (r.doc_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.platform_order_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_fba_removal_item it WHERE it.removal_id = r.id AND it.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')))
ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT FROM ecom_fba_removal r LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = r.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = r.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse dw ON dw.id = r.defective_warehouse_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM ecom_fba_removal WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
